objective: Add a recoverable software travel limit to automatic swing-up: do not terminate the run at the software boundary, block only outward motion, and allow inward motion so swing-up can continue, while retaining physical-limit shutdown safety.
known: The physical plant is the same plant used by the reference model.
The Yaskawa drive has been switched to analog velocity control.
balance auto must home the cart, confirm the downward state, swing up, and switch automatically.
implemented: Four-term LQR with fixed 0.01 second differences
ACC2VOL P=0.18, I=54 and generated-code state ordering
Swing_up m=0.134, g=9.8, l=0.223, J=0.0089, Gain1=5, Gain2=6, position limit=0.25
Velocity limit +/-0.6 m/s and AO limit +/-1 V
100 Hz scheduled control over the existing faster safety monitor
preserved: Physical limit debounce and immediate output shutdown
Fresh two-limit homing and physical-limit hard shutdown
First automatic run measures both limits; later automatic runs reuse the remembered in-process center
Encoder monitoring, manual console, and telemetry logging
removed: Operator gain optimizer and runtime gain mutation

blocking: Physical balance behavior cannot be claimed verified until an operator-authorized supervised hardware run is completed.

current_change.scope: Automatic swing-up command conditioning at the calibrated software travel boundary; manual LQR and physical limit behavior remain fail-stop.
current_change.baseline: The balance loop throws and shuts down whenever the cart reaches maximum_balance_position_fraction, including during automatic swing-up.
acceptance: Automatic swing-up remains active after reaching the 85% software travel boundary.
Commands farther toward the active software boundary are replaced by zero volts.
Commands directed inward are passed through so the controller can recover and continue swing-up.
Command integrators are cleared whenever an outward command is blocked to prevent windup.
Manual-upright LQR still stops at the software boundary.
Physical limits still force AO0=0 V and Servo OFF.
current_change.status: implemented; independent full Release build and phase1_tests passed 1/1 on 2026-09-03; hardware motion not authorized and not run
